title: Canonical pure section in the sheaf tensor product
statement: Let $J$ be a site small in the coefficient universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention], and let $A$ be a sheaf of commutative rings. Use the category $\operatorname{Mod}(A)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], written $\mathrm{scalarModules}(J,A)$ [def-sfb-scalar-hom-comparison-data], and its sheafified balanced tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For $M,N\in\operatorname{Mod}(A)$, an object $U$ of the site, and sections $x\in M(U)$ and $y\in N(U)$, define $\operatorname{pure}_A(M,N,U,x,y)\in(M\otimes_A N)(U)$ to be the image of $x\otimes_{A(U)}y$ under the canonical sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification], followed by the canonical identification of the sheafified presheaf tensor with the monoidal sheaf tensor. Thus this is the canonical local pure-tensor section, without any choice of a tensor-comparison isomorphism.
